How to install Claude Code = 
Claude Code default = 
CorbolPad runs Claude Code without tools (it cannot read files or run commands) and without saving the session: it only receives the text the assistant works on, which is sent to Anthropic. Usage counts toward your subscription limits. =

Installing... = 
CorbolPad has been installed. You can find it in the Start menu. = 
To open a file: right-click → Open with CorbolPad (in Windows 11: Show more options). = 
To always use it for .txt files: right-click a .txt file → Open with → Choose another app → CorbolPad → Always. Or from Settings → Apps → Default apps → CorbolPad. = 
To uninstall it: Settings → Apps → Installed apps → CorbolPad. =
